page.title: Elements
page.intro1: Elements bundle blocks such as text, todos, tables or event lists. Templates are built from elements.
page.intro2: Fixed content works best as a block that is not editable in the protocol.

definition.title: Edit element
definition.description: Element title and its blocks. Click a block to open it.

element.title: Element
element.description: Shared heading in the protocol; the blocks appear below it.

blockDialog.createDescription: Choose the type and set what the block shows in the protocol.
blockDialog.editDescription: All block settings – the same as when creating it.
blockDialog.createFooterNote: Add more blocks to the element after creating it.

help.title: How a block works
help.text: The type defines what is edited in the protocol. “Behaviour” on the right are the defaults; a template can override them per element.

basics.title: Basics
basics.description: Name, heading and hint of this block.
basics.name: Name in the editor
basics.nameHelp: Shown in the block list. In the protocol only if no own heading is set.
basics.heading: Heading in the protocol
basics.headingHelp: Empty: the name is used. If both are empty, the block sits directly below the element title.
basics.hintHelp: Shown below the block heading in the protocol editor, not in the PDF.
basics.contentPlaceholder: Text pre-filled in every new protocol
basics.contentHelp: For non-editable blocks the text appears fixed in the protocol. Cycle placeholders: see right.

repeat.title: Repetition
repeat.description: The block appears once or once per matching event or todo.

optionHelp.none: The block appears exactly once in the element.
optionHelp.event: A separate block is created for every matching event.
optionHelp.todo: A separate block is created for every matching todo.

repeat.unsupported: This type is not meant for repetition. The existing setting stays until you choose “Once”.
repeat.includeUnlistedPast: Also add past matching events that did not appear in the last 3 protocols

syncHelp.event: The block content is also written to this event field (always overwritten). In the Word import, a differing value is decided during review.
syncHelp.todo: The block content is also written to this todo field (always overwritten).

filter.tagsHelp: An event matches if its tag contains one of the values.
filter.title: Title contains
filter.cycleHelp: Relative to the cycle containing the protocol date.
filter.useColumnFilter: Apply column tag filter (otherwise column title)

todo.title: Todo settings
todo.description: Rules for tasks in this block.
todo.dueTagFilterHelp: Only events with these tags are suggested when setting the due date.
todo.assigneeHelp: Open todos from the last protocol are carried over; with a person only theirs.

attendance.title: Attendance
attendance.finesHelp: Set the account and amounts centrally under Finances › Fines › Fine rates.
attendance.excludedHelp: In addition to the people excluded from attendance in the template.

sessionDate.title: Session date
sessionDate.description: Sets the next session date directly in the protocol.

eventList.title: Event list
eventList.description: Which events the list shows and in which columns.
eventList.columnsHelp: Applies in the protocol and the PDF.

finance.description: Account and period of the shown bookings.
finance.balanceDateHelp: On the protocol date, an older protocol also shows the balance valid back then.

fineList.title: Fine list
fineList.description: Shows the fines from the attendance check.
fineList.rangeHelp: Fines of this protocol are always shown.

image.title: Image
image.description: Images are uploaded directly in the protocol.

table.title: Table
table.description: Rows with label and value. Click a row to open the designer.
table.linkedDescription: The table shows a global list; it has no own rows then.
table.linkedListHelp: With a list chosen, the block shows exactly that list from Records › Lists.
table.highlightEmpty: Highlight empty values in protocol and PDF
table.linkedOptionsHelp: These display options apply to this block only, in the protocol and the PDF.

matrix.sectionDescription: Set up rows and columns in the designer.
matrix.empty: No rows yet. Open the designer.
matrix.title: Configure matrix
matrix.description: Where the columns come from and what each row holds per column.

sentence.events: One column per event matching the filter.
sentence.list: One column per entry of the list “{list}”.
sentence.listNone: Choose a list for the columns.

matrix.previewEmpty: No matching entries – check the filter.
matrix.previewPending: Columns are created in the protocol. “Load preview” shows them here.
matrix.columnPlaceholderHelp: Grey hint in the empty column title when columns are managed in the protocol.
matrix.columnTagFilterHelp: Applies to event rows with “Apply column tag filter”. Without its own filter, the column title is used.

designer.dragHint: Drag rows and columns to reorder
designer.countMatrix: {rows, plural, one {# row} other {# rows}} · {columns, plural, one {# column} other {# columns}}

row.label: Label
row.aliasPlaceholder: Leave empty for the list value
row.historicalHelp: Shows the value from the snapshot of the protocol’s cycle. Without a snapshot the current value is used.
row.autoValueHelp: Pre-filled in every automatically created column.

rowTypeHelp.text: A free text field per cell.
rowTypeHelp.participants: Any number of people per cell.
rowTypeHelp.events: Fills each cell with the events matching the filter.
rowTypeHelp.list_entry: A fixed entry from a list.

chart.title: Chart
chart.description: Which statistics chart the block shows.

entryExit.title: Joins/leaves
entryExit.description: Lists joins and leaves since the last protocol.

sessionNotes.note: Shows the notes from the session panel in the protocol and the PDF.

behavior.title: Behaviour
behavior.templateHint: Element defaults. A template can override them per element.

is_editable.label: Editable in the protocol
is_editable.help: Off: content stays fixed as in the template.

export_visible.label: Include in the PDF
export_visible.help: Empty blocks are left out of the export anyway.

is_visible.label: Visible in the editor
is_visible.help: Off: the block is hidden in the protocol editor.

copy_from_last_protocol.label: Carry over from the last protocol
copy_from_last_protocol.help: A new protocol starts with this block’s content from the previous one.

title_as_subtitle.label: Heading as subtitle in the PDF
title_as_subtitle.help: Off: heading in bold instead of a subtitle.

cycleTokens.title: Cycle placeholders
cycleTokens.help: Usable in titles and texts – replaced by the template’s cycle when the protocol is created.

typePicker.title: Choose block type
typePicker.description: The type defines what is edited in the protocol. It can be changed later.

finance.title: Finances
finance.description: Blocks from finance accounts and fines.

organisation.title: Organisation
organisation.description: Automatically filled content about events, attendance and statistics.
